verdict.rationale: Restate's own docs say its durable timers can sleep, send delayed messages, and 'implement patterns like cron jobs'. That gives one-off delayed scheduling natively, but recurring schedules are only a pattern the developer builds from timers, not a documented first-class cron or recurring-schedule feature. missing for 10: native recurring/cron schedule definition, management of recurring schedules (list/pause/edit), worked documentation of the cron pattern, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Restate provides durable, fault-tolerant timers that allow you to: Sleep... Send delayed messages... Set timeouts... Implement patterns like cron jobs
Sleep, schedule, and wait for external events with durable timers.
